strings.zh: 一个精灵球,{NEWLINE}里面装着精灵。
strings.en: A Poké Ball with a Pokémon inside.
strings.notes: Bank 0315: Team Rocket's hidden warehouse off Route 2 (Ariana); the player can claim a dropped Doduo or Barboach.

strings.zh: 唔……上边这一批清点无误,{NEWLINE}这是关东分部的补给。
strings.en: Hmm... This batch up top checks out.{SCROLL}These are the supplies for the Kanto{NEWLINE}branch.

strings.zh: 左边这一批是城都分……
strings.en: The batch on the left is for the Johto{NEWLINE}bran...

strings.zh: 你、你、你……{NEWLINE}你是什么人！{CLEAR}来到我们火箭队仓库干什么！？
strings.en: Wh-wh-who are you?!{SCROLL}What are you doing in Team Rocket’s{NEWLINE}warehouse?!

strings.zh: 我是来收拾火箭队的
strings.en: I came to take down Team Rocket
strings.notes: Choice #4/#5 → responses #6/#7 (male/female player) or #8/#9. | menu width fix (follow-up 1): was 'I’m here to take down Team Rocket'

strings.zh: 我迷路了,误闯进来的
strings.en: I got lost and wandered in

strings.zh: 狂妄的小子,{NEWLINE}我看你是来找死的！
strings.en: Cocky little punk! You must have a{NEWLINE}death wish!

strings.zh: 狂妄的丫头,{NEWLINE}我看你是来找死的！
strings.en: Cocky little girl! You must have a death{NEWLINE}wish!

strings.zh: 既然这样那你快走吧！
strings.en: Well, then hurry up and leave!

strings.zh: 这里北边是尼比市和地鼠洞穴,{NEWLINE}南边是常磐市,{CLEAR}想去哪里赶紧去,{CLEAR}别在我这待着！
strings.en: North of here are Pewter City and{NEWLINE}Diglett’s Cave. South is Viridian City.{SCROLL}Wherever you’re going, get going. Don’t{NEWLINE}hang around here!

strings.zh: 可恶啊……{NEWLINE}这下可怎么办才好……
strings.en: Dammit...{SCROLL}What am I supposed to do now...

strings.zh: 班吉拉『Tyran！！！
strings.en: Tyranitar: Tyran!!!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『哪里来的臭小鬼,{NEWLINE}敢到我们火箭队的仓库来撒野！
strings.en: Ariana: Where did this brat come from,{NEWLINE}daring to make trouble in Team Rocket’s{CLEAR}warehouse!

strings.zh: 雅典娜大人您来啦！{NEWLINE}这下有救了！
strings.en: Master Ariana, you’re here!{NEWLINE}We’re saved!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『既然你已经{NEWLINE}知道了我们的秘密,{CLEAR}那就留你不得了！
strings.en: Ariana: Now that you know our secret...{SCROLL}...I can’t let you live!
strings.notes: | D-1768: user approved explicit lethal meaning of 留你不得 in the witness-killing scene.

strings.zh: 雅典娜『哼,可别以为{NEWLINE}我只有这两只精灵！
strings.en: Ariana: Hmph. Don’t think these two are{NEWLINE}the only Pokémon I have!

strings.zh: 不好了,雅典娜大人,{NEWLINE}尼比市的馆主小刚过来了！
strings.en: Bad news, Master Ariana! Brock, the{NEWLINE}Pewter City Gym Leader, is on his way!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『切,这时候硬碰硬的话……
strings.en: Ariana: Tch. If we go head-to-head{NEWLINE}right now...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你们火箭队{NEWLINE}假扮警察封锁2号路,{CLEAR}原来是因为这里有你们的仓库啊。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So you Team Rocket goons{NEWLINE}dressed up as police and blocked Route{CLEAR}2...{SCROLL}...because your warehouse is here.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『这里的精灵球{NEWLINE}都装着精灵吧？{CLEAR}你们火箭队是要用这些精灵{CLEAR}去做坏事咯？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: All these Poké Balls have{NEWLINE}Pokémon in them, right?{SCROLL}So Team Rocket is going to use these{NEWLINE}Pokémon to do something evil?

strings.zh: 雅典娜『你这黄毛丫头是记者吗？{NEWLINE}还问东问西的。{CLEAR}乖乖给我去死就好了！
strings.en: Ariana: What are you, some reporter,{NEWLINE}you snot-nosed little girl?{SCROLL}Asking all these questions...{NEWLINE}Just be a good girl and die!
strings.notes: zh 黄毛丫头 (little girl) but there's no male variant; kept gender-neutral 'brat'. | RV010: addressee: 黄毛丫头 is a gendered insult to the female player

strings.zh: 雅典娜『你赶紧把这里的精灵球{NEWLINE}都收起来！
strings.en: Ariana: Hurry up and pack away all the{NEWLINE}Poké Balls in here!

strings.zh: 是,雅典娜大人。
strings.en: Yes, Master Ariana.

strings.zh: 雅典娜大人,都收好了。
strings.en: Master Ariana, everything’s packed.

strings.zh: 雅典娜『好,现在撤退！
strings.en: Ariana: Good. Now, retreat!

strings.zh: 雅典娜『哼,今天的帐我先记下了！
strings.en: Ariana: Hmph! I won’t forget this!

strings.zh: 小刚『原来你在这里啊,{VAR:0103:0}。{NEWLINE}我听市民说2号路这边有打斗的声音{CLEAR}就过来看看。{CLEAR}刚刚这附近发生什么事了吗？
strings.en: Brock: So this is where you were,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}.{SCROLL}People in town said they heard fighting{NEWLINE}over on Route 2, so I came to check it{CLEAR}out.{SCROLL}Did something happen around here just{NEWLINE}now?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『其实是这样的……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Well, here’s what happened...

strings.zh: 小刚『火箭队假扮警察封锁2号路,{NEWLINE}还把这里当成仓库！？{CLEAR}这伙人真是太嚣张了,{CLEAR}我这就去跟精灵联盟联系一下,{CLEAR}必须要尽快铲除这个组织了。{SCROLL}小刚『{VAR:0103:0}你在旅行中{NEWLINE}也要多小心啊,{CLEAR}有空欢迎再来我们尼比市玩。
strings.en: Brock: Team Rocket dressed up as police{NEWLINE}to block Route 2, and used this place as{CLEAR}a warehouse!?{SCROLL}These guys are way too brazen. I’ll get{NEWLINE}in touch with the Pokémon League right{CLEAR}away.{SCROLL}We have to root out that organization{NEWLINE}as soon as possible.{SCROLL}Brock: Be careful on your journey too,{NEWLINE}{VAR:0103:0}. Come visit us in Pewter City{CLEAR}again anytime.

strings.zh: 火箭队落下了一个精灵球,{NEWLINE}这里面装着一只精灵,{CLEAR}要拿走吗？{SCROLL}
strings.en: Team Rocket dropped a Poké Ball.{NEWLINE}There’s a Pokémon inside.{SCROLL}Take it?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你身上的精灵带满了！
strings.en: You can’t carry any more Pokémon!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}得到了嘟嘟！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} obtained Doduo!

strings.en: Give Doduo a nickname?

strings.zh: 雅典娜『嘿嘿,就这点本事？{NEWLINE}看来你的死期就是今天了！
strings.en: Ariana: Heh heh, is that all you’ve got?{SCROLL}Looks like today’s the day you die!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那个……我……{NEWLINE}我迷路了！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Um... I... I got lost!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『哎呀,我是不小心迷路{NEWLINE}才走到这里来的。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Oh dear, I got lost and ended{NEWLINE}up here by accident.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我来看看你们火箭队{NEWLINE}到底在搞什么阴谋！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: I came to see what scheme{NEWLINE}Team Rocket is cooking up!

strings.en: {VAR:0103:0} obtained Barboach!

strings.en: Give Barboach a nickname?
